shortDescription: Japan's current account surplus stood at 4.062 trillion yen ($25.7 billion) in August, Ministry of Finance data showed on Thursday.That compared with economists' median forecast for a surplus of 3.19 trillion yen in a Reuters poll.($1 = 158.0600 yen)
